neighbours.label: 'of' after source/supply words, predicting a life-sustaining resource (water, food, energy)
fire: Bees travel for miles because clover fields provide their best source of pollen.
During the drought, the old well remained the only source of drinking water.
Marsh plants serve wading birds as a dependable supply of food.
For the islanders, coconuts were a vital source of nourishment all year.
Sheep on the moor rely on heather as their winter source of forage.
Long ago the forest gave the settlers their main source of fuel.
In the desert camp, that spring was a precious source of water for camels.
Deep-sea microbes use the vents as an abundant source of energy.
quiet: Bees travel for miles across the clover fields of central France.
During the drought, the old well became the subject of local legend.
Marsh plants line the banks of the slow river near the town.
For the islanders, coconuts were the symbol of a famous festival every year.
Sheep on the moor were counted by the owner of the estate.
Long ago the forest hid the source of the rumor about the settlers.
In the desert camp, that spring was the site of a brief skirmish.
Deep-sea microbes puzzle the authors of the latest survey of the vents.
